scripts.start:home: concurrently -k -r "npm:dev" "sh -lc 'npx wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:$PORT/ --timeout 120000 && open -a "Google Chrome" http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/'"
scripts.port:free: sh -c 'P=${PORT:-5174}; for p in $P 3001 3000; do PIDS=$(lsof -tiTCP:$p -sTCP:LISTEN -n -P || true); if [ -n "$PIDS" ]; then echo Killing on $p: "$PIDS"; kill -9 $PIDS; fi; done'
scripts.start:one: npm run port:free && npm run start:home
scripts.start:sim: concurrently -k -r "npm:dev" "sh -lc 'npx wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:$PORT/ --timeout 120000 && npm run sim:open'"
scripts.start:all: npm run port:free && cross-env PORT=5174 HOST=127.0.0.1 BROWSER=none concurrently -k -r "npm:dev" "sh -lc 'npx wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:$PORT/ --timeout 120000 && PORT=$PORT bash ./scripts/open-browsers.sh'"
scripts.preview: npm run preview:build && npm run preview:start
scripts.quick:social: cross-env PORT=0 npm run port:free && serve public -l tcp://127.0.0.1:3002 -n
scripts.quick:social:open: sh -lc 'npm run quick:social & sleep 1 && npm run open:social'
scripts.voice-backend: HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=5005 SIMPLE_TTS_ENABLED=1 python3 ../voice_server.py || HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=5005 SIMPLE_TTS_ENABLED=1 python ../voice_server.py
scripts.voice-backend-full: HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=5005 python3 ../voice_server.py || HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=5005 python ../voice_server.py
scripts.dev:all:sim: npm run port:free && cross-env PORT=5174 HOST=127.0.0.1 BROWSER=none concurrently -k -r "npm:voice-backend" "npm:dev" "sh -lc 'npx wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:$PORT/ --timeout 120000 && npm run sim:open'"
